name: File Explorer Plugin
description: Recursive file tree browser displayed in a sidebar panel. Directories sorted first with expand/collapse toggle (▶/▼ arrow indicators). Context menus via ContextMenu: files (Copy Path, Paste (as copy), Delete, 'Open to Markdown' for .md with MarkdownPlugin labels), directories (New File, New Folder, Copy Path, Paste, Delete). Inline text input for instant file/folder creation (Enter commits, Escape cancels). Copy/paste with _copy_N auto-naming for duplicates. Delete confirmation through ConfirmModal. 500ms debounced external file change refresh via fs:onChanged. Color-coded file type icons (TS, JS, JSON, HTML, CSS, SVG, Markdown, Python, Rust, Go, C/C++, etc.). Scroll wheel propagation stopped to prevent canvas zoom.

dependencies.usage: Right-click menus on files and directories

interface.constructor: new FileExplorerPlugin(container: HTMLElement, rootPath: string, onFileOpen: (path: string) => void)

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reload current visible tree while preserving expand state

methods.name: setMarkdownOpeners
methods.signature: (labels: string[], callback: (filePath: string, label: string) => void) => void
methods.description: Set available markdown viewer labels and callback for 'Open to Markdown'

features.context_menus: File: Copy/Paste/Rename/Delete/Open to Markdown. Directory: New File/New Folder/Copy/Paste/Rename/Delete
features.inline_creation: Type name in inline input, Enter to commit, Escape to cancel
features.copy_paste: Copy stores path, paste with _copy_N numbering for duplicates
features.file_icons: Color-coded by extension type (TS#3178C6, JS#F0DB4F, JSON#F0DB4F, HTML#E34F26, CSS#2965F1, SVG#FFB13B, MD#C8D6E5, PY#3572A5, RS#DEA584, GO#00ADD8, C#283593, C++#00599C, etc.)
features.external_refresh: 500ms debounced tree reload on file:changed event
